battlefields.name: THE SPINE
battlefields.canon: A surviving linear Lattice backbone used to teach new commanders the clean geometry of jurisdiction.

battlefields.name: THE DELTA
battlefields.canon: Two isolated channels built around an Old Weather water-management bank.

battlefields.name: THE NARROWS
battlefields.canon: Three surviving emplacement alcoves force local defense without mutual support.

battlefields.name: SHATTERED
battlefields.canon: The ground is broken into isolated islands by an ancient gate-shear event.

battlefields.name: CROSSROADS
battlefields.canon: Two claims and two lanes cross around a monument whose original authority is no longer recognized.

battlefields.name: THE COIL
battlefields.canon: A closed industrial circuit where heat, pursuit, and return paths overlap.

battlefields.name: THE EXPANSE
battlefields.canon: An exposed survey array with almost no natural cover and unusually long sightlines.

battlefields.name: THE RIFT
battlefields.canon: A broken translation channel that creates discontinuous threat geometry.

battlefields.name: CONFLUENCE
battlefields.canon: Three command records are simultaneously valid and none can erase the others.

battlefields.name: THE CROWN
battlefields.canon: An old authority node designed to place every claimant under observation.

battlefields.name: CAROUSEL
battlefields.canon: Traffic was once assigned dynamically; modern commanders experience it as shifting pressure.

battlefields.name: THE ORRERY
battlefields.canon: A physical model of local orbital and gate relationships that still controls access.

battlefields.name: THE LATTICE
battlefields.canon: The underlying connection graph is visible enough that placement becomes constitutional topology.

battlefields.name: THE CAUSEWAY
battlefields.canon: A narrow connection between separated jurisdictions whose loss would erase lawful continuity.

battlefields.name: THE ANVIL
battlefields.canon: A Machine industrial foundation built to survive impacts and continuous heavy manufacture.

battlefields.name: THE LANCE
battlefields.canon: An accelerator and calibration route that rewards exact range and alignment.

battlefields.name: THE SKEW
battlefields.canon: The map and the local field disagree about straight lines.

battlefields.name: THE STRAIT
battlefields.canon: Traffic streams were designed to pass rather than fight; war turns that efficiency against itself.

battlefields.name: THE LOOM
battlefields.canon: Multiple path threads become one legal and logistical fabric.

battlefields.name: THE OSSUARY
battlefields.canon: Its archive rejects Echo Reversal, so the dead remain dead and every kill loses strategic afterlife.

battlefields.name: THE ATOLL
battlefields.canon: A circular settlement ecology whose center owns the life-support charter.

battlefields.name: THE MAELSTROM
battlefields.canon: A Lattice node that admits too many simultaneous claims and solves the conflict as a twenty-seat arena.
